purpose: Archive the existing single-example inference benchmark; not a dataset-wide timing study.
scope: One prespecified canonical test example Davis/xml6/TX1, observation mask4101, 2% each of7bands; batch1 jointly produces all7maps.
fixed_example_selection: Lexicographically first (city,xml_idx,tx_idx) of canonical test160, selected before timing.
precision: FP32 without autocast; TF32 disabled; only intermediate coarse round trip mimics the existing FP16 cache.

measurement.method_order: Rotate three-method starting position each repetition; explicit device synchronization before/after every timed call.
measurement.clock: time.perf_counter synchronized wall latency; no CUDA graphs/compilation/autocast.
measurement.single_example_limitation: One fixed input is a controlled microbenchmark, not a dataset-wide latency distribution.

boundaries.mf_two_stage_preloaded: Fresh original Stage1 forward including its dynamic anchor-neighbor calculation; clamp; GPU label-gather projection and original-cache-equivalent FP16 round trip; original Stage2 forward; original hard observation consistency.
boundaries.unet_preloaded: Concatenate device-resident raw sparse maps/masks/original side; original strong U-Net forward; clamp; original hard observation consistency.
boundaries.mf_stage2_only_cached_prior: Original Stage2 forward and hard consistency from preloaded saved coarse prior. This is explicitly NOT full two-stage runtime.
boundaries.excluded_for_all: Model/checkpoint loading, file I/O, graph/side construction, pixel-to-region sparse-feature aggregation, mask generation, host-to-device copies, target scoring, plotting.
boundaries.graph_reuse: Static graph, labels, features, side and observation tensors preloaded. Neighborhood search performed inside Stage1 forward is included.

side_context: Each system retains its actual source side/context, which differs by graph resolution; same target/sparse/masks/valid/eval hashes asserted. This is an implementation latency comparison of existing systems, not an all-inputs-identical architecture ablation.
csv_serialization: UTF-8 with LF line endings; all 300 original CSV records retained.
verification: Median and mean for all three methods independently recomputed from all 100 repetitions per method.
